notes: Seed URL loads (CIRA page). No Clarity site (elections.json 404). Results are scanned Electionware reports; the 2024 precinct report has an OCR text layer, the 2026 primary summary was read visually. Last-Modified differs per file (meaningful). Printed footer times run later than PDF creation and upload times (2024: printed 10:06 PM vs upload 9:42 PM), so the printing machine clock is not reliable. 2024 general had an unofficial precinct-by-precinct report on election night (END); in 2026 the county posted only a county summary (primary, 4:01 AM next morning) or nothing unofficial (runoff), with precinct numbers only in official canvass reports.
tag_rationale: 2026 primary and runoff are LATER by check 2 (2024 general is END), so the rule gives COUNTY_ONLY_PRECINCT_AT_CANVASS; neither LATER election has an election-night upload time, so confidence is low.

2024_general.fact: 'LEON COUNTY UNOFFICIAL PRECINCT BY PRECINCT REPORT' (110524 UNOFFICIAL PCT BY PCT.pdf, 42 pages, OCR text): 'Summary Results Report UNOFFICIAL RESULTS 11/05/24 General Election w/BISD & OISD ... Pct #1 - Centerville ... TOTAL Absentee Early Voting Election Day ... Precinct Summary - 11/05/2024 10:06 PM'; per-precinct candidate votes including Election Day. PDF CreationDate Wed Nov 6 03:21:33 2024 UTC; Last-Modified Wed, 06 Nov 2024 03:42:06 GMT (9:42 PM CST Nov 5). County summary 'UNOFFICIAL FINAL ALL PRECINCTS' Last-Modified 03:06:28 GMT (9:06 PM CST). One precinct report on election night, with the final unofficial count.

2026_primary.fact: 'LEON COUNTY UNOFFICIAL TOTALS' (030326 JOINT PRIMARY UNOFFICIAL RESULTS 0001.pdf, scanned, read visually): 'Election Summary Results Report 2026 Primary Election March 3, 2026 ... UNOFFICIAL RESULTS Leon County, Texas ... Election Day Precincts Reporting 14 of 14'; county totals; footer 'Election Summary - 03/04/2026 12:15'. CreationDate Wed Mar 4 09:59:23 2026 UTC; Last-Modified Wed, 04 Mar 2026 10:01:27 GMT (4:01 AM CST Mar 4). No unofficial precinct report listed; precinct numbers only in 'Official Canvass of Election Precinct by Precinct Results'.

2026_runoff.fact: Runoff results listed are only '05/26/26 Official Precinct Report-Group Detail' (file prefix 062226), '05/26/26 Canvass Totals for Joint Primary Run-Off Election', and a preliminary reconciliation; no unofficial or election-night results file is listed. Precinct numbers appear only in the official (canvass) report.
